text: {"final": {"verdict": "accept", "reason": "The proposed logistics/routes.py matches the ticket and the actual code. best_route, routes_between, sites_served, trips_needed, CAPACITY and DEFAULT_VEHICLE are kept unchanged; only imports (adding can_pass) and the two new functions are added. passable_route loads the network like best_route, filters routes_between results with any(all(can_pass(road, v, network) ...)) over ('truck','van') — matching can_pass's signature in logistics/access.py — returns None when nothing is usable, picks min by (r['km'], r['id']) like best_route, and returns truck only if a truck can use every road, else van. rerouted_sites compares route ids (best[0]['id'] != passable[0]['id']), so a vehicle-only change does not count, and returns sites in name order; it correctly omits sites where passable_route returns None (no usable route found). Checked against data/network.json: SITE-CPL-B reroutes RT-05→RT-06 (van, R-08 closed, R-09 restricted), SITE-HGL-A reroutes RT-07→RT-08 (truck, R-12 closed), while SITE-NVL-B and SITE-HGL-B keep their best route with a van (R-03/R-13 restricted) and are correctly not listed."}}
reasoning:
Check the proposed edit against the ticket.

passable_route: enumerates routes_between, filters usable where any vehicle can pass all roads, picks min by (km, id), returns truck if truck can pass all roads else van. Matches ticket.

rerouted_sites: ticket says "the sites, in name order, for which passable_route finds a route that is different from the route best_route picks (the vehicle alone changing does not count)."

The proposed rerouted_sites iterates over warehouses and sites served, compares best[0]["id"] != passable[0]["id"]. That compares route ids — vehicle change doesn't count. Good.

But wait: what if best_route returns None (no route) but passable_route returns a route? Can't happen since passable only considers routes from routes_between, so if passable exists, best exists. If best exists but passable is None — site has no usable route; ticket says "sites for which passable_route finds a route that is different" — if passable returns None, it doesn't find a route, so not included. The proposed code requires both best and passable and different ids. That matches.

Edge: what if best and passable are the same route id but different vehicle? Not counted — correct.

Also, ticket says rerouted_sites(network=None) -> list[str]. Proposed signature matches.

One subtlety: rerouted_sites iterates warehouses sorted, sites served sorted, then returns sorted(out) — fine, name order.

Check can_pass usage: can_pass(road, v, network) — signature can_pass(road_id, vehicle, network=None). Correct.

Check that passable_route handles the case where route has roads... fine.

Check the "Done when" — trucks sent whenever route allows: passable_route returns truck if truck can use every road. Correct.

Check best_route unchanged: yes, identical.

Check imports: from logistics.access import can_pass, load_network — access.py has both. math still imported for trips_needed. CAPACITY, DEFAULT_VEHICLE kept.

One thing: passable_route docstring/behavior — "A route is usable if at least one vehicle (a truck or a van) may use every road on it." Implemented with any/all. Correct.

Potential issue: rerouted_sites — should it consider sites across all warehouses? Yes, iterates all warehouses in network routes. Fine.

Also duplicate sites? sites_served returns unique sorted. Fine.

Verify with data: e.g., SITE-NVL-B: best is RT-02 (22km, roads R-01 A, R-03 R) — truck can't use R-03, van can. So RT-02 is usable (van). passable_route picks RT-02 (22 < 31), vehicle van. best route id == passable route id → not rerouted. Correct per ticket: vehicle alone changing doesn't count.

SITE-CPL-B: best RT-05 (18km, R-07 A, R-08 X) — no vehicle can pass R-08, unusable. RT-06 (26km, R-07 A, R-09 R) — van only, usable. passable returns (RT-06, van). Different id → rerouted. Correct.

SITE-HGL-A: best RT-07 (20km, R-10 A, R-12 X) unusable. RT-08 (27km, R-10, R-11 both A) — truck can pass all → (RT-08, truck). Rerouted. Correct.

SITE-HGL-B: RT-09, R-13 R — van only, usable, same route as best → not rerouted. Correct.

Everything checks out. Accept.
